title: Roma Musical, Artistic, and Social History
grammar: Distributive frequency and allocation: -nként, -anként, -enként, -onként ('per / every / by')
goal: I can describe the rich musical, artistic, and social heritage of Hungary's Roma communities.
I can form and apply the distributive suffixes (-nként, -anként, -enként, -onként) to indicate rate, distribution, and cadence.
I can analyze traditional Roma craft professions, virtuoso Gypsy orchestra traditions, and contemporary civic initiatives.
